property_summary: For any caller, calling updateAlloSettings(newAddr) by the contract owner (owner() == msg.sender) always sets c.alloSettings() to newAddr; the mutant that checks owner() == address(0) instead can allow the call to revert or prevent owner from updating, so there exist inputs (an owner caller and some newAddr) where reference updates alloSettings but mutant does not.
change_summary: Change onlyOwner modifier to check against msg.sender being the zero address instead of the owner, effectively disabling owner checks for real owners and altering who can call updateAlloSettings.
